name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Health Mate Infrared Saunas can offer a number of positive features: the sauna units are very effective, safe and coma at a reasonable price to meet the demands of any customer. An easy way to battle various health problems, effectively relieve any possible every day stress and improve your mood without leaving your home!



In making the infrared sauna units, only the finest materials and latest technology is used, combined with a very easy assembly and an ability to fit in almost any space at home. The saunas are made to withstand the passing of time and will last a very long time, making the sauna sessions very comfortable, relaxing and reviving.



Among the main variety of features there are – a choice of different types of heaters (they can be either Carbon, or Ceramic), a built-in sound system to upgrade experience in every session and help relax with music, reading lights to enjoy a book or a magazine (additional feature includes a magazine holder), oxygen ionizers, etc. And to top that there is a Five year Warranty on any electrics, heating elements, structure and wood.
